The target video is a living two-color risograph print in <Subject 1>: every shape keeps its orange and blue ink grain, hatching and slight misregistration as it moves, like animated screen-printed frames.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The crowd's raised fists pump slowly and the flares hiss and spit on the asphalt. The camera pushes forward between the silhouettes and through the rolling smoke at a steady speed in one continuous move, the shield wall growing larger until the scratched shields fill the frame, the flare light and the raised fists of the crowd reflected across them. The camera is still pushing in as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
